answers.sommelier_long: "I tend to gravitate toward traditional Rioja Reservas — I'm a big fan of producers like Ardanza, Muga, and Tondonia — though I also enjoy the occasional Rhône, so anything in that style would work beautifully. My budget sits around £20–£45 GBP, and I prefer wines with some age and structure over fruit-forward styles."
